editorial:
Imagine you are on a road trip with your partner and a new baby, just trying to get to your family. Everything seems fine until a flat tire turns into a total nightmare. You get to know Claire and Ned, a couple who suddenly find themselves stranded in the middle of nowhere. After a bad accident leaves Ned badly hurt and unable to move, the vibe shifts from a simple trip to a scary game of survival. You will feel the tension as Ned starts seeing things in the dark, convinced that something evil is watching them from the trees. It really makes you wonder if he is just losing his mind from the pain or if there is actually a monster outside.

What really works here is how the movie keeps you guessing about what is real. The acting is solid, and the slow build-up of fear keeps you on the edge of your seat. While the pace starts a bit slow, the payoff is worth it. If you love thrillers that mess with your head, you should definitely check this out.
endingExplained: The big twist is that the scary things Ned saw were not real monsters, but a setup. It turns out Claire was the one plotting against him all along. She wanted to get rid of Ned to take the money and the baby for herself. She staged the accident and played with his mind to make him feel crazy. In the end, Ned realizes he was betrayed by the person he trusted most before the trap finally closes.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves psychological thrillers with a big twist ending.
